title: 柱色谱
source_doc: course/高校实验室安全/174_柱色谱.md
author_source: project/高校实验室安全/174_柱色谱/src.py

shots.scene: 欣欣站在通风柜里一根装好的色谱柱旁
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a tall glass chromatography column clamped upright in a fume hood, colored bands inside and a rack of test tubes below, looking at the camera.
shots.narration: 第15章第十二课：柱色谱。

shots.scene: 阿杰在开放台面上猛倒硅胶粉，粉尘飞扬
shots.prompt_en: The young male student dumps fine white silica powder from a big jar on an open bench, a white dust cloud rising around his face, a red warning icon.
shots.narration: 阿杰在台面猛倒硅胶粉，粉尘飞扬。

shots.scene: 他把烧杯举过头顶倒浆，柱子没夹牢
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a beaker raised above head height pouring slurry into a wobbly unclamped glass column, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 烧杯举过头顶倒，柱子还没夹牢。

shots.scene: 柱子跑干开裂，小研摇头
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student points at a glass column whose white packing has run dry and shows cracks, shaking her head at the young male student.
shots.narration: 小研：柱子跑干裂了，全白做了。

shots.scene: 复习：色谱按极性分离
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two molecules moving through an adsorbent, the polar one held back, the nonpolar one moving ahead. No text.
shots.narration: 复习：色谱按极性的差别来分离。

shots.scene: 薄层板只能分一点点，样品多用柱子
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a tiny spot on a chromatography plate beside a flask with a large amount of crude oil, an arrow to a glass column. No text.
shots.narration: 薄层板只分一点点，样品多用柱色谱。

shots.scene: 最常用的纯化方法，常分离克级样品
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a column with a gram scale icon and a check mark, practice repetition arrows. No text.
shots.narration: 有机实验最常用的纯化法，多练就熟。

shots.scene: 玻璃柱底部有活塞，内装硅胶
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a glass column with a stopcock at the bottom, packed with white silica gel, sand layers above and below. No text.
shots.narration: 柱底有活塞，里面装硅胶或氧化铝。

shots.scene: 硅胶是固定相，洗脱剂是流动相
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: solvent flowing down through the white packing, labeled with two simple icons for still phase and moving phase. No text.
shots.narration: 硅胶是固定相，洗脱剂是流动相。

shots.scene: 极性大的吸附强走得慢
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a magnified silica surface with hydroxyl groups holding a polar molecule while a nonpolar molecule passes by quickly. No text.
shots.narration: 硅胶表面吸附极性分子，极性大走得慢。

shots.scene: 编号试管分批接馏分
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the column outlet dripping into a row of numbered test tubes, two colored bands going into different tubes. No text.
shots.narration: 柱下用编号试管，一份份接馏分。

shots.scene: 快速柱：柱顶加压，更快更好
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a gentle pressure arrow at the top of a column pushing solvent through faster, a clock icon. No text.
shots.narration: 快速柱：柱顶加压，跑得快分得好。

shots.scene: 用前检查柱子无裂纹，用专用耐压柱
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a magnifier checking a glass column for cracks, a cracked column crossed out, a heavy wall column suited for pressure checked. No text.
shots.narration: 加压前查裂纹，用专用耐压玻璃柱。

shots.scene: 只用低压，按本室规程
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a low pressure gauge needle in a green zone with a regulated gentle air line, a needle in the red zone crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 只用低压，绝不超过玻璃承受能力。

shots.scene: 接头别卡死，要能泄压
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a pressure adapter held on loosely with a release path, a tightly clamped adapter with a bulging cracked column crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 接头别卡死，压力过高会胀裂柱子。

shots.scene: 戴护目镜，柜门放低当挡板
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a student in safety goggles behind a lowered fume hood sash acting as a shield, a clamped column inside. No text.
shots.narration: 戴护目镜，柜门放低或加防护屏。

shots.scene: 选对溶剂体系是成败关键
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a key icon over two solvent bottles, one less polar and one more polar, mixed into one. No text.
shots.narration: 选对溶剂体系，是成败的关键。

shots.scene: 一极性一非极性，两种互溶溶剂
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two miscible solvents blending in different ratios, a polarity slider between them. No text.
shots.narration: 一般一极性一非极性，两种互溶。

shots.scene: 点几块板，各用不同比例展开
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: several chromatography plates developed in jars with different solvent ratios, the plate adsorbent matching the column packing. No text.
shots.narration: 点几块板试比例，吸附剂要和柱子一样。

shots.scene: 常用：乙酸乙酯配正己烷
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two solvent bottles with flammable pictograms mixed for a common system, plus a low boiling pair and a polar pair as alternatives. No text.
shots.narration: 最常用乙酸乙酯配正己烷。

shots.scene: 主成分比移值约0.3
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a plate with the main spot at about three tenths of the way up, highlighted. No text.
shots.narration: 调极性，让主成分比移值约零点三。

shots.scene: 太低出柱太慢，太高分不开
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a spot near the bottom with a slow snail icon and a spot near the top with two spots merging, both crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 太低出柱慢，太高跑太快分不开。

shots.scene: 两种组分，让两点中点在0.3
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two spots on a plate with their midpoint marked at three tenths of the height. No text.
shots.narration: 分两种，让两点的中点在零点三。

shots.scene: 极性相差大，用梯度洗脱
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a solvent gradient bar from less polar to more polar beside a column releasing one band and then the next. No text.
shots.narration: 极性相差大，可用梯度洗脱。

shots.scene: 先冲最不极性的，再慢慢提极性
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the least polar band eluting first at about three tenths, then the solvent made gradually more polar to push the next band. No text.
shots.narration: 先冲最不极性的，再慢慢提极性。

shots.scene: 还有凝胶等填料，可自动化
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: columns sorting by size, charge and polarity with simple icons, and a generic automated chromatography unit without logos. No text.
shots.narration: 填料还有凝胶等，大规模可自动化。

shots.scene: 细硅胶粉尘吸入有害
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: fine silica particles drifting toward a nose and lungs icon, a caution sign, a cough icon. No text.
shots.narration: 细硅胶粉是呼吸道危害，别吸入。

shots.scene: 在通风柜里称取，倒粉要轻
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: silica gently scooped into a large flask inside a fume hood, no dust cloud, the sash at the marked height. No text.
shots.narration: 硅胶一律在通风柜里取用，倒粉要轻。

shots.scene: 称进大瓶，装量不超过三分之一
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a large conical flask filled with silica to only one third of its height, a full small flask crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 称进大锥形瓶，不超过三分之一。

shots.scene: 必要时戴防颗粒物口罩
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a student in safety goggles and a particle filtering respirator handling silica in the hood. No text.
shots.narration: 粉量大时，按要求戴防颗粒物口罩。

shots.scene: 洗脱剂易燃，用量大
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: several large bottles of flammable eluent and a long rack of open test tubes, a flammable pictogram. No text.
shots.narration: 洗脱剂多易燃，一次要用很多。

shots.scene: 柱子周围不能有明火和热源
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a flame and a glowing hot plate kept away from the column area in the hood, crossed out near the column. No text.
shots.narration: 柱子周围不能有明火和热源。

shots.scene: 按需取用，瓶子和馏分随手盖
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: only the needed volume poured out, solvent bottles capped and filled tubes covered, extra bottles returned to the cabinet. No text.
shots.narration: 按需取用，溶剂瓶馏分管随手盖好。

shots.scene: 硅胶约为样品的二十倍
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a small sample pile beside a silica pile twenty times larger, a balance icon. No text.
shots.narration: 好分时，硅胶约为样品的二十倍。

shots.scene: 难分离要五十到一百倍
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a much larger silica pile for a difficult separation, a question icon pointing to an experienced person. No text.
shots.narration: 难分要五十到一百倍，拿不准就问。

shots.scene: 选柱径：硅胶高十五到十八厘米
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three columns, one too tall and thin with a spread band, one too short and wide, and one in the middle with packing about fifteen to eighteen centimeters checked. No text.
shots.narration: 选柱径，让硅胶高约十五到十八厘米。

shots.scene: 查柱子和活塞有无裂纹、漏液
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a magnifier over a glass column and stopcock, a cracked tip crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 先查柱子和活塞，有没有裂纹漏液。

shots.scene: 【实拍】关活塞，柱底塞一小团棉花
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a gloved hand checks that the stopcock is closed, then a long glass rod gently pushes a small tuft of cotton down to the narrow bottom of an empty column.
shots.narration: 确认活塞关好，柱底塞一小团棉花。

shots.scene: 棉花轻压别塞太紧
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: cotton centered at the bottom lightly pressed checked, cotton jammed hard crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 棉花轻压到中心，别塞太紧。

shots.scene: 【实拍】铁架台竖直夹牢
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: the column clamped firmly and perfectly upright to a stand inside a fume hood, a small level check against the glass.
shots.narration: 用铁架台和夹子，竖直夹牢。

shots.scene: 备齐烧杯、滴管、漏斗、溶剂、硅胶和砂
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: beakers, a dropper, a powder funnel, a solvent bottle, a flask of silica and a small jar of sand laid out in the hood. No text.
shots.narration: 备齐烧杯、滴管、漏斗、溶剂和砂。

shots.scene: 【实拍】加一薄层砂
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: clean fine sand poured through a funnel into the column, forming a thin flat layer on top of the cotton.
shots.narration: 在棉花上铺一薄层砂。

shots.scene: 【实拍】滴管冲下壁上的砂，砂面要平
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a dropper rinses sand grains off the inner wall with water, then the column is tapped lightly until the sand surface is level.
shots.narration: 冲下壁上的砂，轻敲让砂面水平。

shots.scene: 硅胶加洗脱剂调成能流动的匀浆
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: eluent added to silica in a large flask and swirled with a rod into a smooth pourable slurry. No text.
shots.narration: 硅胶加洗脱剂，调成能流动的匀浆。

shots.scene: 柱里先加一段溶剂
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a few centimeters of solvent above the sand layer in the column before the slurry goes in. No text.
shots.narration: 柱里先加一段溶剂作缓冲。

shots.scene: 摇匀后经漏斗低位小心倒入
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the slurry swirled and poured steadily through a funnel at chest height, a beaker raised above the head crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 摇匀后在胸前低位，经漏斗倒入。

shots.scene: 溶剂冲净烧杯、漏斗和柱壁
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a little eluent rinsing the leftover silica from the flask, the funnel and the column wall into the column. No text.
shots.narration: 余下的硅胶，用溶剂冲进柱里。

shots.scene: 干法装柱易生气泡，推荐湿法
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a column packed with dry powder showing trapped bubbles crossed out, a wet packed even column checked. No text.
shots.narration: 干粉装柱易出气泡，一般用湿法。

shots.scene: 开活塞轻敲，硅胶面平整
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the stopcock opened, a rubber tool tapping the column wall, the silica settling into an even flat bed. No text.
shots.narration: 开活塞，轻敲柱壁，让硅胶面平整。

shots.scene: 低压压实，液面留五到八厘米
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: gentle pressure applied at the top to pack the bed, stopped when liquid is about five to eight centimeters above the silica. No text.
shots.narration: 低压压实，放到硅胶上方五到八厘米。

shots.scene: 不能有气泡、裂缝
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a packed bed with air bubbles and a crack crossed out, a uniform bed checked. No text.
shots.narration: 检查：不能有气泡和裂缝。

shots.scene: 匀浆调稀、边装边敲
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three tips, a thinner slurry, tapping while pouring, and pressure applied before opening the stopcock. No text.
shots.narration: 匀浆调稀，边装边敲，减少气泡。

shots.scene: 冲下壁上硅胶
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a dropper rinsing silica stuck on the column wall down onto the flat bed. No text.
shots.narration: 硅胶面平了，先冲下壁上的硅胶。

shots.scene: 【实拍】小心加一薄层顶砂
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a thin layer of sand sprinkled gently onto the liquid above a white packed bed, settling flat without disturbing it.
shots.narration: 小心加一薄层砂，别扰动硅胶面。

shots.scene: 液面绝不能低于硅胶顶面
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the solvent level always above the top of the packing checked, a dry top crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 液面绝不能降到硅胶顶面以下！

shots.scene: 跑干就开裂，前功尽弃
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a dried column with white cracks and channels, the bands smearing, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 跑干了柱子开裂，分离就不准了。

shots.scene: 上样前放到略高于砂面
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the stopcock opened to lower the solvent until it is just above the top sand, then closed. No text.
shots.narration: 上样前，液面放到略高于砂面。

shots.scene: 样品用尽量少的溶剂溶解
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a crude oil in a small flask dissolved in a very small volume of solvent, a large dilute volume crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 样品用尽量少的溶剂溶解。

shots.scene: 必须完全溶解；难溶加几滴二氯甲烷
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a fully clear sample solution checked, a cloudy one crossed out, a few drops of a halogenated solvent added in the hood. No text.
shots.narration: 一定完全溶解，难溶加几滴二氯甲烷。

shots.scene: 用更极性的溶剂上样，谱带变厚
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a sample loaded in a strong polar solvent spreading into a thick band crossed out, a narrow band checked. No text.
shots.narration: 用更极性的溶剂上样，谱带太厚。

shots.scene: 【实拍】滴管贴近砂面沿壁一圈滴加
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a long dropper with colored water held close to the sand surface, releasing drops slowly in a circle around the inner wall.
shots.narration: 管口贴近砂面，沿壁一圈慢慢滴。

shots.scene: 放低液面，荡洗原瓶再加
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the liquid lowered to the sand, the sample flask rinsed with a little solvent and added the same way, repeated once or twice. No text.
shots.narration: 放低液面，少量溶剂荡洗原瓶再加。

shots.scene: 先加一层溶剂缓冲，再慢慢加满
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a little eluent added gently by dropper as a cushion, then the column slowly filled to the top without stirring the sand. No text.
shots.narration: 先滴一层溶剂缓冲，再慢慢加满。

shots.scene: 沙层下一条窄谱带
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a thin even colored band just below the top sand layer, a check mark. No text.
shots.narration: 做得好，砂层下是一条窄谱带。

shots.scene: 溶不动就用干法上样
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a sample that will not dissolve in the eluent, an arrow to a dry loading icon. No text.
shots.narration: 样品在洗脱剂里溶不动，用干法上样。

shots.scene: 溶解后加少量硅胶摇匀
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the sample dissolved in a little solvent in a round bottom flask, a small scoop of silica added and swirled, inside the hood. No text.
shots.narration: 溶好转入圆底瓶，加少量硅胶摇匀。

shots.scene: 旋蒸前防暴沸球塞擦拭纸
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a bump trap with a few folded lab wipes inside, then attached to a rotary evaporator with clamps. No text.
shots.narration: 旋蒸前，防暴沸球里塞几张擦拭纸。

shots.scene: 蒸到能自由流动的细粉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a free flowing fine powder checked, a sticky clumped mass crossed out with an arrow to redissolve and add more silica. No text.
shots.narration: 蒸成能自由流动的细粉，结块就重做。

shots.scene: 倒在砂层上，再冲壁、加砂、加满
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the coated silica poured onto the top sand over a thin layer of solvent, then rinsed down, topped with sand and filled with eluent. No text.
shots.narration: 倒在砂层上，冲壁、加砂、加满溶剂。

shots.scene: 备足溶剂和一大架试管，马上开跑
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: plenty of eluent and a large rack of test tubes ready, a clock showing the column started right after loading. No text.
shots.narration: 备足溶剂和试管，上样后马上开跑。

shots.scene: 流速：不是慢滴，也别成水柱
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the outlet flow as a fast steady stream of drops checked, a slow drip and a solid jet both crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 调流速：不是慢慢滴，也别成水柱。

shots.scene: 连续换管，别让试管溢出
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a hand moving the rack so each tube fills and the next one takes over, an overflowing tube crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 连续换管收集，别让试管溢出来。

shots.scene: 盯住液面，沿壁勤补溶剂
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: eyes watching the solvent level, fresh eluent poured gently down the wall before it reaches the sand. No text.
shots.narration: 盯住柱内液面，沿壁勤补溶剂。

shots.scene: 色带分开，分批收集
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a green mixture band separating into a yellow band and a blue band, each going into different tubes, a single flask collecting both crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 色带分开了，接在一瓶就又混了。

shots.scene: 一块板点五六个馏分
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a chromatography plate with five or six fraction spots side by side, the capillary rinsed between fractions. No text.
shots.narration: 看不见就点板，一块板点五六个馏分。

shots.scene: 展开剂选能拉开斑点的
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the developed plate showing which fractions contain which spot, a solvent chosen to spread the spots apart. No text.
shots.narration: 展开剂选能拉开斑点的，不必同柱子。

shots.scene: 也可用紫外吸收或比色
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a simple light absorption icon and a color comparison icon as other ways to check fractions. No text.
shots.narration: 也可用紫外吸收或比色来鉴定。

shots.scene: 理想：一管一个化合物，中间有空管
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a row of fraction spots showing compound one, then empty tubes, then compound two, a check mark. No text.
shots.narration: 理想：一管一个化合物，中间有空管。

shots.scene: 全挤在几管：柱太小或溶剂太极性
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: all spots crowded into a few overlapping fractions, icons of a small column and a strong solvent. No text.
shots.narration: 挤在几管：柱太小或溶剂太极性。

shots.scene: 拖得很长：柱太高或上样溶剂太多
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a spot trailing across many fractions, icons of a too tall column and too much loading solvent. No text.
shots.narration: 拖很长：柱太高或上样溶剂太多。

shots.scene: 纯品馏分合并，混合馏分留着
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: pure fractions poured into a round bottom flask no more than half full, mixed fractions set aside in a labeled rack. No text.
shots.narration: 纯馏分合并，混合馏分留着再纯化。

shots.scene: 荡洗试管并入，烧瓶不过半
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: each test tube rinsed into the flask, the flask filled to less than half. No text.
shots.narration: 荡洗试管并入，烧瓶装不过一半。

shots.scene: 旋蒸先通冷凝水，瓶要完好夹牢
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a rotary evaporator with cooling water on first, a crack free flask clamped to the joint, vacuum released before removing the flask. No text.
shots.narration: 旋蒸先通冷凝水，瓶完好夹牢。

shots.scene: 拿到产品前一管都不倒
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a rack of fractions all kept and labeled, a hand pouring a tube into a waste container crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 拿到产品之前，一管都别倒掉。

shots.scene: 在通风柜里推干废硅胶
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: inside a fume hood, a little alcohol added to the used column and a low air push drying the silica, sash lowered. No text.
shots.narration: 确认无产物，在柜内推干硅胶。

shots.scene: 废硅胶、废液分类收集
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: dry used silica poured into a labeled solid hazardous waste bag in the hood, eluent into organic waste and halogenated waste into its own container, a sink crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 废硅胶进固废，卤代废液单独收。

shots.scene: 样品少用滴管做微量柱
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a glass dropper clamped upright with a cotton plug, dry adsorbent, sand, sample and sand layers. No text.
shots.narration: 样品少，用滴管做个微量柱。

shots.scene: 另一支滴管从上加溶剂
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a second dropper adding eluent from the top, a small vial collecting below. No text.
